answer: Make time the one input a farm cannot mint. Each identity keeps a private journal sealed in a vault, posting only its hash each epoch; to vote or trade, it must open an entry written ten epochs earlier and show that it committed then to something checkable now. A lone agent's entries line up like juniper rings, one per season, grown in order. A sybil spun up today has no past to open, and a thousand spun up together all share the same thin first ring; when the gale of a sudden ballot arrives, only roots grown slowly over many epochs hold.
